server_host.description: Host address of the Mir display server (empty or localhost for local only)

server_port.description: TCP port number for Mir server communication

kiosk_user.description: System user account under which the kiosk session runs

auto_start_x_server.description: Automatically start the X server on kiosk launch if not already running

applications.description: List of applications to launch in kiosk mode

command.description: Full path and command to execute (may include arguments)

icon.description: Optional path to application icon (file or resource)

working_dir.description: Working directory for the application process

autostart.description: Whether to automatically launch this app at startup

x_server_args.description: Extra arguments passed to the X server (e.g., ['-nolisten', 'tcp'])

wayland_socket_path.description: Path to Wayland socket for Mir-Wayland compatibility (leave empty to use default)

enable_touch.description: Enable touch input support (recommended for touchscreen kiosks)
